intro: Kids level up by asking why. Play the latest live build, then help choose what comes next.
features: What should Curiosity Craft add next?
featureHint: Upvote any features you want. One vote per feature per visitor. Add one comment per feature to unlock another surprise.
f-spawn-worlds: More spawn worlds: cave, ice, volcano, space
f-ai-drawings: Wonder Board understands drawings with AI
f-teacher-mode: Teacher mode: upload a lesson to create a world
f-why-monster: Why Monster: beat a boss by asking good questions
countsNote: Players = visitors who opened the game page. Shares = share-button uses, not confirmed posts. Onboarded = people who left a comment or email.
rewardsTitle: Vote. Tell us why. Unlock a surprise.
incentives: SF LARP photos, funny SF facts, Corvus secrets, a Gabe X shout-out draw, a 1:1 call raffle and a chance Gabe spawns anywhere in the world to say thanks.
raffleNote: No email needed for photos or surprises. Optional adult/parent email is private and only for contacting selected raffle entries; visits are by mutual agreement.
commentTitle: Why this feature? What would make it better?
commentHint: No names, emails, school details or phone numbers in public comments. One new comment per upvoted feature.
adult: I am 18+ or a parent entering for my child.
consent: Use my email only to contact me about the rewards and raffles.
commentDone: Already commented on these features? Upvote another to unlock a new comment and reward.
suggestDone: Suggestion saved. Thanks for shaping the game!
shared: Share opened / link copied. Your reward is below.
noComments: Be the first curious voice here.
error: Couldn’t confirm that yet. Check the form and try again.
by: Curiosity Craft by Sudhersan K V and Gabe
waitBody: The embedded game may be slow or blocked. You can always open the latest build directly.
lucky: 8 languages, because 8 is lucky: in Chinese, 8 (ba) sounds like fa, to prosper. Beijing opened its 2008 Olympics on 08/08/08 at 8:08 pm.
hackTitle: Beta Fund x Epic: Multimodal AI for Education Hackathon
eventBody: Nov 13 2026 · Snowflake Silicon Valley AI Hub. Multimodal learning with measurable outcomes; at least two modalities, a 3-minute demo, 4pm deadline. Judges include Epic and an audience vote.
buildingBody: Curiosity Craft: kids ask why, explore worlds and learn by trying, including the experiments that flop. Sudhersan’s live app is embedded directly: no manual syncing.
plan: X: 3 draft posts · Instagram story + reel “help us pick” · TikTok “what should we build next?” · LinkedIn · Discord/friends DMs · live event demo + QR · Twitch build stream
kvRole: Sudhersan K V — building remotely today; car trouble turned this into an online hack
fact-fog: Cool ocean air can bring fog through the Golden Gate. The hills create a patchwork of microclimates.
fact-cable: SF cable cars grip a moving cable under the street. The first line opened in 1873.
fact-duck: Golden Gate Park is larger than New York’s Central Park. Plenty of room for curious sidequests.
raven: You found the raven 🐦‍⬛ · Curiosity badge unlocked!
